name: baoyu-podcast-summary
description: Summarizes podcasts, interviews, panels, and other conversation transcripts into an objective, reader-first summary written in the user's preferred language. Leads with the few takeaways worth keeping, retells them faithfully with clear speaker attribution, and adds no opinions of its own. Accepts a pasted transcript, a transcript file, or a YouTube URL (transcript fetched through baoyu-youtube-transcript), infers unnamed speakers from context, and uses web search to verify names and supply back
author: JimLiu
